original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: For the fixed four-role target diag([A+P],[A+Q],[B+P],[B+Q]), extend the legal rational rank-one address alphabet by R=(1,1/2)^T(1,1/2). Determine whether any exact six-call word exists in F2[ZA+ZP+ZR] with factors I+([F]-1)N for F in {A,B,P,Q,R} and rank-one idempotents N in M4(F2).
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card permits a specified new legal operation alphabet. This keeps the four roles and target of Cycle 21 but adds one exact rational rank-one frame, directly answering that predecessor package open question. The changed lattice may lower the first-order floor, so a full six-call identity check is justified.
bottleneck_link: A completed saving in this favorable paid-call model could be relevant to the bit primitive only after native frame construction, addition, precision, and interface charges. The pinned selected result still has the complex primitive binding; this scoped obstruction supplies no supplier or kappa change.
stop_rule: Enumerate all 65,536 first-order masks and every six-call word permitted by the unique minimum mask pattern. Stop after the full 388,800-candidate set; do not search seven-call words in this cycle.
evidence: The added address gives an index-four over-lattice with basis (A,P,R), B=2A+4P-4R and Q=3A+3P-4R. Exact rank/trace minimization gives a six-call global floor and a unique visible mask pattern. Every six-call candidate then has two Q projectors summing to diag(1,0,0,1), two P projectors summing to diag(0,1,1,0), and two identical R projectors. The complete set has 388,800 ordered words. Exact multiplication in F2[ZA+ZP+ZR] finds none equal to the unchanged target. The direct eight-call word remains valid, so this excludes a two-call saving and proves only a lower bound of seven, not an exact minimum.
author: Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scope selection, exact lattice and cost derivation, overlap review, finite search implementation, verification, and package writing.

open_questions.question: Does a seven-call word exist in the same five-address four-role model?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The six-call obstruction raises the lower bound to seven but leaves open whether the added rational address still saves one paid call over the direct eight-call word.
open_questions.first_step: Derive all first-order count profiles with two R calls and total visible cost at most five, then test a complete exact word search only if the resulting candidate set has a favorable bounded size.
open_questions.blocked_by: Seven-call first-order profiles include one extra call beyond the unique six-call pattern, and the current cycle intentionally stopped at the first possible two-call saving.
